posts.title: Geek Up, TOS Down
posts.description: GOOD NEWS FOR POTTY-MOUTHED ARCHIVISTS! A chap called Jon Williams has brilliantly converted 2006’s interactive DVD Beat The Geek into a playable browser game. I’ve had a quick test run and it seems indistinguishable from the real thing; it basically feels like a DVD emulator within your browser. Even the mini-games work. There’s a Github… Read More

posts.title: It’s the Connecting Wall!
posts.description: About a week ago, I had a dream that there was a DwarfCast -themed connecting wall on an episode of Only Connect . For those not familiar with the programme, it's a quiz show where the aim is to find links between seemingly unconnected clues. In this particular round, there are four sets of four connections, all jumbled up and displayed as sixteen items on a big wall. The task is to identify each
